title: Improve a Code Ladder translation
summary: The Code Ladder shows EasyScript as C for Aven's native tier, and as Unity C#, Godot GDScript, Roblox Luau and Unreal C++. Some commands aren't translated yet (the notes say 'has no single matching command' or 'isn't in the C API yet'). Add one.
why: Better translations help people move on to other engines with confidence.
learn: How the same idea is written in different engines

steps.text: In the Code Ladder, find a note saying a command has no single matching command, for the engine you know best.
Open engine/src/aven/script/translate.cpp (other engines) or translate_c.cpp (Aven C) and find the global() or method() function where commands are mapped.
Add the translation, following the ones around it. Check the other engine's documentation for the right call.
Add a check to tests/test_translate.cpp that your translation appears.
Build and run the tests: cmake --build build && build/bin/aven_tests

submit: Open a pull request. Put 'Quest: improve-the-code-ladder' in the description and say which engine you checked against.
